title: EMR-Spark Job creating max 1000 partitions/task when AQE is enabled
question:
I see always 1000 task/partitions getting created for a spark jobs with AQE enabled. If I execute job for monthly(4 times weekly data) or a week data, the shuffle partitions are same.Whis is nothing but number of task running is 1000. Hence it's throwing memory issues. Is there any parameter enables max 1000 partitions.

Spark submit: As part of AQE, I have not enabled spark.sql.shuffle.partitions. Rather

spark-submit --conf spark.sql.files.maxPartitionBytes=268435456 \ --master yarn --deploy-mode cluster --conf spark.yarn.maxAppAttempts=1 \ --conf spark.sql.adaptive.enabled=true --conf spark.dynamicAllocation.enabled=false \ --conf spark.sql.adaptive.coalescePartitions.enabled=true \ --conf spark.sql.adaptive.advisoryPartitionSizeInBytes=64m \ --conf spark.sql.adaptive.optimizeSkewsInRebalancePartitions.enabled=true \ --conf spark.sql.adaptive.coalescePartitions.minPartitionNum=30000 \
answer: Default value in EMR-spark cluster have spark.sql.adaptive.coalescePartitions.initialPartitionNum=1000, which was limiting 1000. Please look at thi slink below. https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ReleaseGuide/emr-spark-performance.html
